column1: US INDIVIDUAL ACCOUNTS RANKED BY SHARE VELOCITY
Built top-down from the country. NOT filtered or scored for Making Cinderella — the prior version was, and that was the error.
⚠️ ESTIMATES. Share counts are not public on most platforms. SHARE is an ABSOLUTE scale: estimated shares/retweets on a typical well-performing post.
⭐ EST_SHARES_PER_DAY is the ranking metric = (est. shares per post) x (est. posts per day).

⚠️ Multiplying the 1-10 indexes together was WRONG and produced the previous bad ranking: SHARE is logarithmic and cadence is linear, so a ~250x real gap between Trump and a niche account compressed into 2x. Hence absolute units.
SCOPE: individuals only. No aggregators, brands, leagues or podcast properties — no Barstool, House of Highlights, NBA, Pardon My Take, Dude Perfect, Sidemen. A podcast HOST is in; the show is not.

US-based. Non-US-born athletes in US leagues are included and flagged (Ohtani, Giannis, Wembanyama, Doncic, SGA). Fully non-US accounts excluded (Ronaldo, Messi, KSI, Khaby, McGregor, Adesanya, Peterson).
⚠️ Avowed extremist accounts are omitted — an editorial call, stated so it is visible. ⚠️ NOT EXHAUSTIVE: an estimated top ~370, not every individual account in America.
In_MC_List is neutral cross-reference metadata only. It does NOT affect the ranking.
Overwrite any SHARE or Cadence cell to substitute your own judgment; the per-post / per-day columns are lookups you can also overwrite, and Rank recalculates.
